# Toronto Computes! — Chris Talbot’s review

- Original title: Robin Hood on the PC
- Source: [Original publication](https://www.scribd.com/document/488631632/2003-05-Toronto-Computes)
- Author / publisher: Chris Talbot; Toronto Computes!, May 2003, page 51; digitized copy on Scribd
- Language / date: English; May 2003
- Access: Substantial OCR text inspected; original page layout not visually verified.
- Checked: 2026-09-09

Talbot describes a mixture of tactical strategy and role-playing adventure, with optional money-making missions alongside plot progression. The brief review judges the adaptation successful and the game enjoyable overall.

Its presentation assessment is restrained: animations are smooth, but graphics sometimes look dated; music and effects work well, while voices sound melodramatic. The scan’s OCR interleaves columns and neighboring advertisements, so the summary uses only clearly legible review passages. Garbled system requirements and advertisement numerals are not treated as game specifications or a review score.
